content.short: Esper Finance is a community-driven DEX built on Mantle Network for efficient token trading, liquidity provision, and ecosystem governance.
content.description: Esper Finance is a decentralized exchange purpose-built for the Mantle Network community, emphasizing community governance and ecosystem alignment by giving token holders a direct voice in protocol decisions and fee distribution. The protocol provides standard AMM swaps alongside liquidity mining incentives designed to attract and retain long-term liquidity providers within the Mantle DeFi ecosystem.
